run_dedup_all: run dedup_all.py to deduplicate parallel training data across all language directions in a folder
run_dedup_with_directions: run dedup_all.py with --directions flag to deduplicate specific language pairs like en-de,de-en
run_dedup_auto_discover: run dedup_all.py to auto-discover language directions from train files and deduplicate them
review_deup_function: review the deup function from utils.dedup that deduplicates source and target parallel files
refactor_direction_parsing: refactor the direction parsing logic in dedup_all.py to support additional file naming conventions
